environment: Docker Compose on Linux; local services only; fresh application volumes
duration_scope: Provisioning, checks and capture; excludes final teardown

versions.mailpit: /mailpit v1.33.0 compiled with go1.27.3 on linux/amd64
versions.mariadb: mariadb from 11.8.9-MariaDB, client 15.2 for debian-linux-gnu (x86_64) using  EditLine wrapper

checks.name: browser submission matches SQLite row and Mailpit message
repeated and concurrent retries create no extra row or mail
reference reuse with changed fields is rejected
invalid input cannot reach either destination
unsigned webhook cannot write a sheet row
mail outage returns pending and retains the actual row
sheet outage returns pending without claiming delivery
both undelivered entries remain in the persistent WordPress outbox
direct n8n replay is idempotent at both destinations
formula-like input stays text and CSV export neutralises it
saved enquiry opens in LibreOffice Calc with matching spreadsheet cells
